sequences.timing: Native ScreenCapture requests at LastPostLateUpdate, approximately every 0.2 realtime seconds for 7 seconds. UV, UTC and frame clocks are recorded at request time; the actual screenshot dimensions are read back. Fighter idle pose/camera are frozen by the offline fixture; background OffsetScrolling runs at its authored speed.

motion.limitation: Phone/tablet recorded in separate sessions. Frame UTC/UV are capture-request measurements. Native PNG frames remain whole; GIF may align relative time and loop replay is not a tile seam.

gif.limitation: Actual separate Editor recordings aligned by relative realtime. ScreenCapture UV clocks are recorded at request time. Full frames are scaled for this comparison. The GIF repeats its recorded segment, so the playback-loop jump is not a game texture seam. This is not a device recording.

independentNativePhaseProbe.scope: Clone-only Editor instrumentation; all six scrollers paused. Nondefault raw UV rectangles are recorded immediately before and after native Return/HOME reload, and checked before any fixture CenterUV. Separate immutable Final After provides actual moving-speed evidence. This companion does not recheck resize/reference recovery or player compilation.
